name: index-month-start-morning
why: The ETF specialty has nine barren agents and three losing traders, while permissive replay passes do not establish profitability. Test the distinct calendar-linked investment-flow hypothesis through at most $2 of fractional SPY during a fixed morning window on each month's first three observed trading sessions. This intraday expression is unproven, not an established calendar premium or a repair of the overnight strategy. Completed daily bars identify sessions; fresh quotes, a bounded spread, one exposure, one daily entry attempt, working-order management and an early scheduled exit constrain execution. Preserve applicable selection history and require coverage, after-cost replay, sealed holdout, independent paper observations, audit and capital gates. Reject insufficient trades rather than widening the calendar to force activity.
